statement: For weak-anchor slow tumblers, the anchor-cap (dt_ab<π/ω_hi, the aliasing cure) forces a close-and-weak B anchor whose fixed-2° cell count makes the A×B cross intractable (seed 116: B=ep52 = 4.6% admission → 40941 cells → 211M cross pairs; coarse-6° localize → 16.4M). The s111 adaptive coarsening was LOAD-BEARING for cross-tractability, so the bug-fix that removed it blocks slow-tumbler generality of the as-built pipeline until the cross is redesigned to be weak-anchor-aware (C-anchor pre-prune of B, or a connectability-tube cross).
